the pricing of medical consultations in the private sector in Brazil has a direct relationship with the quality and perceived value by the patient.
the price of medical services is determined by the market forces, which include the demand and supply.

medical consultation prices are influenced by several factors that include: (i) The medical professional’s training and specialization; (ii) the location and the medical professional’s prestige in the community; (iii) the medical professional’s experience and reputation; (iv) the medical professional’ s time and availability to the patient; (v) the patient’s perception of the medical professional’s competence and the quality of care; and (vi) the medical professional's willingness to negotiate the price.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the pricing strategy of the medical consultation and how to improve the quality and perceived value in this service.
the pricing of medical consultations, and the factors that influence the price of this service.
the price of medical consultation and how to define a price that is consistent with the quality of service provided.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the price of medical services must be based on the value of the services provided, which in turn depends on the perception of the customer, the quality of the service provided, the cost of providing the service and the market price.
a medical service is not a commodity, but a service, and therefore should be priced as such, taking into account all the factors that influence the final value of the medical service.
the medical consultation is a service with a high degree of complexity and that it should be priced accordingly.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the price of medical consultation is a variable that is influenced by many factors, and the most important are: the quality of care, the perception of the value of care, the cost of care, and the competition between medical professionals.
the medical consultation is a complex service that has a high degree of variability and uncertainty.

the medical professional is responsible for the quality and perceived value that customers have of its services, but the price should be based on the market, the competition and the cost of providing the service.

the medical professional must be able to identify the factors that affect the value of its services to the customer and to understand how to price them, in order to be competitive, and at the same time, maintain its business.
the medical service is a product that can be sold, and the price is a variable that can be adjusted, but it must be in line with the value perceived by the customer.
